entities.title: Let a save report that its record was not written
entities.summary: PilotStore::write returns nothing, so a failed write is silent and the pilot is told the save worked.
entities.compromise: PilotFiles::write drops the io::Error from try_write because the trait cannot carry it; FlyInSystem::save answers Saved either way.
entities.cost: A pilot whose disk is full or folder is unwritable believes they saved, and loses the run on death or on quitting.
acceptanceCriteria: A failed write reaches the save's outcome
SimHost::save_pilot answers not_written and the pilot page says so

origin.description: PilotFiles::write's comment, and the ⚠️ in bridge.md (Saving).
